title: Text: DET Greg Garno ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: I got like 15 of these to tweet out. How would you suggest I do it in as less annoying as possible
Like a countdown every 10 minutes or something? Schedule tweets
If you want, you can do one giant thread all at once
Ooh a thread, good call. What if I spaced them out every five minutes?
If you want, that would work
OK. Safe travels my dude, enjoy the weather
Hope o get to see you down there
The Cavs are getting smashed .... “The Tigers lost by 32 points. Andre Drummond had 19 points. Time of game: XX hours, XX minutes”
Lmao at you thinking you’re just off the hook for me asking you about tweets
Laughed at “Lmao at you thinking you’re just off the hook for me asking you about tweets”
Like, I’m confused at where I’m at so I put the Tigers because the team I’m watching got smoked
Oh, I haven’t been on twitter because I’m just getting to Tampa. That said, if you’ve got some tweets that preface it then ship it.
